verses.geez: ወአደ፡ ተናገር፡ ኤልፋዝ፡ ቱሜናዊ፡ ተሰጥወ፡ ወይቤ።
verses.translation: Then Eliphaz the Thæmanite answered and said,

translations.lxx: Then Eliphaz the Thæmanite answered and said,
translations.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
translations.ron: Elifaz din Teman a răspuns atunci şi a zis:

verses.geez: ቀዳሚሁ፡ አኮኑ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይሜህር፡ ምክረ፡ ወጥበበ።
verses.translation: Is it not the Lord that teaches understanding and knowledge?

translations.lxx: Is it not the Lord that teaches understanding and knowledge?
translations.kjv: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
translations.ron: "Poate omul să fie de vreun folos lui Dumnezeu? Nu, fiindcă înţeleptul îşi este de folos lui însuşi.

verses.geez: ወምንት፡ ያጽሕቆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ለአመ፡ አንተ፡ አንጻሕክ፡ ምግባሪከ፡ ወምንተ፡ ይረብኆ፡ ለአመ፡ አንተ፡ አርታዕከ፡ ፍናዊከ።
verses.translation: For what matters it to the Lord, if thou wert blameless in thy works? or is it profitable that thou shouldest perfect thy way?

translations.lxx: For what matters it to the Lord, if thou wert blameless in thy works? or is it profitable that thou shouldest perfect thy way?
translations.kjv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
translations.ron: Ce are Cel Atotputernic dacă tu eşti fără prihană? Şi care este câştigul Lui, dacă drumurile tale sunt fără vină?

verses.geez: ይትሓሰበከኑ፡ ወይትዋቀሰከ፡ ወየሐውርኑ፡ ይሳነን፡ ምስሌከ።
verses.translation: Wilt thou maintain and plead thine own cause? and will he enter into judgment with thee?

translations.lxx: Wilt thou maintain and plead thine own cause? and will he enter into judgment with thee?
translations.kjv: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
translations.ron: Oare El te pedepseşte pentru cucernicia ta şi pentru ea intră cu tine în judecată?

verses.geez: ቀዳሚሁ፡ አኮኑ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ውእቱ፡ እከይከ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ኍልቊ፡ ለኃጣውኢከ።
verses.translation: Is not thy wickedness abundant, and thy sins innumerable?

translations.lxx: Is not thy wickedness abundant, and thy sins innumerable?
translations.kjv: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
translations.ron: Nu, dimpotrivă, fiindcă răutatea ta este mare şi fărădelegile tale sunt fără hotar!

verses.geez: ወአኀዝኮ፡ ለከንቱ፡ ወሰለብከ፡ ልብሶ፡ ለዕሩቅ።
verses.translation: And thou hast taken security of thy brethren for nothing, and hast taken away the clothing of the naked.

translations.lxx: And thou hast taken security of thy brethren for nothing, and hast taken away the clothing of the naked.
translations.kjv: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
translations.ron: Căci tu fără dreptate luai zăloage de la fraţii tăi şi smulgeai veşmântul de pe oameni şi-i lăsai goi.

verses.geez: ማየ፡ ጥቀ፡ ኢያስተይኮ፡ ለጽሙአ፡ ወሄድከ፡ አፍእሞቶ፡ ለርኁብ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ዘይዘርእ፡ ሎቱ፡ ምድረ፡ ገጸ፡ መዳልው፡ ይነብር፡ ውስቴታ።
verses.translation: Neither hast thou given water to the thirsty to drink, but hast taken away the morsel of the hungry.

translations.lxx: Neither hast thou given water to the thirsty to drink, but hast taken away the morsel of the hungry.
translations.kjv: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
translations.ron: Tu nu dădeai să bea celui însetat şi nu dădeai să mănânce celui flămând;

verses.geez: ወቦ፡ እለሂ፡ እንከርከ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ወጸላእከ፡ ነዳያነ፡ በዓመፃ፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And thou hast accepted the persons of some; and thou hast established those that were already settled on the earth.

translations.lxx: And thou hast accepted the persons of some; and thou hast established those that were already settled on the earth.
translations.kjv: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
translations.ron: Cel cu pumnul tare cotropeşte pământul şi cel cu trecere îl ia, în stăpânire.

verses.geez: ወአውፃእኮን፡ ለዕቤራት፡ ዕራቆን፡ ወአፅዐርኮ፡ ለእጓለ፡ ማውታ።
verses.translation: But thou hast sent widows away empty, and hast afflicted orphans.

translations.lxx: But thou hast sent widows away empty, and hast afflicted orphans.
translations.kjv: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
translations.ron: Goneai de la pragul tău pe văduve cu mâinile goale şi braţele celor orfani tu le sfărâmai.

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ምንትኑ፡ ዓገተከ፡ መሥገርት፡ ወሮደከ፡ ጻባኢት፡ ኃያል።
verses.translation: Therefore snares have compassed thee, and disastrous war has troubled thee.

translations.lxx: Therefore snares have compassed thee, and disastrous war has troubled thee.
translations.kjv: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
translations.ron: Acesta este cuvântul pentru care laţuri te înconjoară şi spaimele te-au apucat dintr-o dată.

verses.geez: ወብርሃንከሂ፡ ጽልመተ፡ ኮነከ፡ ወደፈነከ፡ ማይ፡ እንዘ፡ ትነውም።
verses.translation: The light has proved darkness to thee, and water has covered thee on thy lying down.

translations.lxx: The light has proved darkness to thee, and water has covered thee on thy lying down.
translations.kjv: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
translations.ron: Lumina s-a stins pentru tine şi nu mai vezi şi o apă revărsată te-a dat la fund.

verses.geez: ወኢኮነሁ፡ ብውሐ፡ ልዑል፡ ይግበር፡ ዘፈቀደ፡ ወያኃሥሮሙ፡ ለጸአልያን።
verses.translation: Does not he that dwells in the high places observe? and has he not brought down the proud?

translations.lxx: Does not he that dwells in the high places observe? and has he not brought down the proud?
translations.kjv: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
translations.ron: Dumnezeu nu este El oare mai presus de ceruri? Priveşte în sus spre stele cât de sus sunt ele!

verses.geez: ወትቤ፡ ምንተ፡ የአምር፡ ኃያል፡ ወበላዕለ፡ ጽልመትኑ፡ ይኴንን።
verses.translation: And thou hast said, What does the Mighty One know? does he judge in the dark?

translations.lxx: And thou hast said, What does the Mighty One know? does he judge in the dark?
translations.kjv: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
translations.ron: Tu ai zis: Ce ştie Dumnezeu! Judecă El oare prin umbră?

verses.geez: ወደመና፡ ይሤውሮ፡ ወኢሬኢ፡ ዓውደ፡ ሰማይኑ፡ የሐውር።
verses.translation: A cloud is his hiding-place, and he shall not be seen; and he passes through the circle of heaven.

translations.lxx: A cloud is his hiding-place, and he shall not be seen; and he passes through the circle of heaven.
translations.kjv: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
translations.ron: Norii sunt ca o perdea în faţa Lui şi El nu poate să vadă; El se plimbă numai de jur împrejurul cerurilor.

verses.geez: ፍኖቶሂ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ተዓቅብ፡ እንተ፡ ኬድዋ፡ እደው፡ ጻድቃን፡ እለ፡ ዓርጉ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይትዓወቅ፡ ከመ፡ ፈለግ፡ ዘይውኅዥ፡ መሠረታቲሆሙ።
verses.translation: Wilt thou not mark the old way, which righteous men have trodden?

translations.lxx: Wilt thou not mark the old way, which righteous men have trodden?
translations.kjv: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
translations.ron: Voieşti tu să urmezi pe străvechea cale pe care au bătătorit-o oamenii cei fără de lege?

verses.geez: ወእለ፡ ይብሉ፡ ምንተ፡ ይሬስየነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወምንተ፡ ይመጽአ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ወመልአ፡ ሎሙ፡ አብያቲሆሙ፡ በረከተ።
verses.translation: who were seized before their time: their foundations are as an overflowing stream.

translations.lxx: who were seized before their time: their foundations are as an overflowing stream.
translations.kjv: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
translations.ron: Cei ce au fost măturaţi înainte de vreme, când un fluviu s-a rostogolit peste temeliile lor,

verses.geez: ወምክረ፡ ኃጥአንሰ፡ ርኍቅ፡ እምኔሆሙ።
verses.translation: Who say, What will the Lord do to us? or what will the Almighty bring upon us?

translations.lxx: Who say, What will the Lord do to us? or what will the Almighty bring upon us?
translations.kjv: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
translations.ron: Şi ei ziceau lui Dumnezeu: "În lături de la noi! Şi ce poate să ne facă Cel Atotputernic?"

verses.geez: ወርእዮሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ሰሐቱ፡ ወተሳለቁ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ንጹሐን።
verses.translation: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from him.

translations.lxx: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from him.
translations.kjv: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
translations.ron: Dar tocmai El umpluse casele lor de bunătăţi, însă sfatul celor răi rămânea departe de Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: ወጠፍአት፡ ንዋዮሙ፡ ወተረፎሙሂ፡ በልዓት፡ እሳት።
verses.translation: The righteous have seen it, and laughed, and the blameless one has derided them.

translations.lxx: The righteous have seen it, and laughed, and the blameless one has derided them.
translations.kjv: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
translations.ron: Cei drepţi se uită şi se bucură, iar cel nevinovat râde de ei.

verses.geez: እስኩ፡ ኩን፡ እኩየ፡ እመትጸንዕ፡ ወአመ፡ ይሤኒ፡ ፍሬከ።
verses.translation: Verily their substance has been utterly destroyed, and the fire shall devour what is left of their property.

translations.lxx: Verily their substance has been utterly destroyed, and the fire shall devour what is left of their property.
translations.kjv: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
translations.ron: Iată, avuţia lor a nimicit-o şi focul a mistuit toată strânsura lor!

verses.geez: ሕትቶ፡ ለነገረ፡ አፉከ፡ ወደይ፡ ቃሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ልብከ።
verses.translation: Be firm, I pray thee, if thou canst endure; then thy fruit shall prosper.

translations.lxx: Be firm, I pray thee, if thou canst endure; then thy fruit shall prosper.
translations.kjv: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
translations.ron: Împacă-te cu Dumnezeu şi cazi la pace. Atunci bine va fi de tine.

verses.geez: እመሰ፡ ነሳሕከ፡ ወአሕመምከ፡ ርእሰከ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወአርኃቀ፡ እምልብከ፡ ዓመፃ።
verses.translation: And receive a declaration from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

translations.lxx: And receive a declaration from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
translations.kjv: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
translations.ron: Primeşte, te rog, învăţătură din gura Lui şi pune la inimă cuvintele Lui;

verses.geez: ይተክለክ፡ ዲበ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ወከመ፡ እብነ፡ ፈለግ፡ ይሰፍፍ።
verses.translation: And if thou shalt turn and humble thyself before the Lord, thou hast thus removed unrighteousness far from thy habitation.

translations.lxx: And if thou shalt turn and humble thyself before the Lord, thou hast thus removed unrighteousness far from thy habitation.
translations.kjv: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
translations.ron: Dacă te întorci la Cel puternic şi te smereşti, dacă depărtezi nedreptatea de cortul tău,

verses.geez: ወይረድእከ፡ እምፀርከ፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ፡ ወያገብአ፡ ለከ፡ ንጽሐከ፡ ከመ፡ ብሩር፡ ጽሩይ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt lay up for thyself treasure in a heap on the rock; and Sophir shall be as the rock of the torrent.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt lay up for thyself treasure in a heap on the rock; and Sophir shall be as the rock of the torrent.
translations.kjv: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
translations.ron: Atunci aurul tău îl vei preţui drept ţărână şi comorile Ofirului drept pietricele,

verses.geez: ወትረክብ፡ ሞገስ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወትኔጽር፡ ሰማየ፡ ተፈሢሐከ።
verses.translation: So the Almighty shall be thy helper from enemies, and he shall bring thee forth pure as silver that has been tried by fire.

translations.lxx: So the Almighty shall be thy helper from enemies, and he shall bring thee forth pure as silver that has been tried by fire.
translations.kjv: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
translations.ron: Pentru că Cel Atotputernic va fi pentru tine sloi de aur şi grămezi de argint.

verses.geez: ወዘጸለይከ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ይሰምዐከ፡ ወይሁበከ።
verses.translation: Then shalt thou have boldness before the Lord, looking up cheerfully to heaven.

translations.lxx: Then shalt thou have boldness before the Lord, looking up cheerfully to heaven.
translations.kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
translations.ron: Atunci tu te vei desfăta întru Cel Atotputernic şi ridica-vei faţa ta către Dumnezeu.

verses.geez: ወየዓሥየከ፡ ፍዳ፡ ጽድቅከ፡ ወያበርህ፡ ውስተ፡ ፍናዊከ።
verses.translation: And he shall hear thee when thou prayest to him, and he shall grant thee power to pay thy vows.

translations.lxx: And he shall hear thee when thou prayest to him, and he shall grant thee power to pay thy vows.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
translations.ron: Tu vei chema numele Lui şi El te va auzi şi tu vei împlini juruinţele tale.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አሕመመከ፡ ትብል፡ ተዓበየ፡ ለዘያቴሕት፡ ርእሶ።
verses.translation: And he shall establish to thee again a habitation of righteousness and there shall be light upon thy paths.

translations.lxx: And he shall establish to thee again a habitation of righteousness and there shall be light upon thy paths.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
translations.ron: Când te vei hotărî să faci un lucru, lucrul îl vei izbuti şi lumina va străluci pe toate drumurile tale,

verses.geez: ወይባልሖ፡ ለንጹሕ፡ ወትድኀን፡ በንጽሐ፡ እደዊከ።
verses.translation: Because thou hast humbled thyself; and thou shalt say, Man has behaved proudly, but he shall save him that is of lowly eyes.

translations.lxx: Because thou hast humbled thyself; and thou shalt say, Man has behaved proudly, but he shall save him that is of lowly eyes.
translations.kjv: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
translations.ron: Fiindcă Dumnezeu smereşte pe mândri şi mândria, şi mântuieşte pe acela care-şi pleacă ochii în pământ.
